hypothesis: A decoder-built diagonal multi-timescale reservoir with online fixed-point readout can replace enough of the expensive compact recurrent endpoint over the same-execution FX2 endpoint to close the 681.114 B/M baseline debt at much lower runtime.

decision.reason: Development-only selection chooses the zero-update control and realizes no gain. The best post-hoc full replay saves only 5 B/M, regresses three blocks, and has negative development loss, versus 681.114 B/M required before code.
decision.next_action: Do not expand diagonal cell or learning-rate ladders. A future fast recurrent replacement must introduce cross-state interactions, token/event inputs, or teacher-trained dynamics rather than independent leaky byte hashes.

claim_boundary: Causal same-execution FX2 probability-trace replay only. No native archive, runtime qualification, counted integration, full-corpus replay, or official score exists.
